goal: Make 3,000 short tons of salt per day instead of 2,500 (+20 %). Find what limits it and propose the most economical design that passes every engineering check: process, operating envelope, electrical, compressor curves and start-up, uncertainty. Where a check needs data the case does not have (a vendor curve), name it instead of guessing.
